description: PORTAL (Portland Oregon Regional Transportation Archive Listing) is the official transportation data lake for the Portland, Oregon and Vancouver, Washington metropolitan region, run from the Transportation Research and Education Center office at Portland State University. It collects, archives and shares data from regional public agencies, mostly received in real time or daily through automated retrieval. Its pages show corridor volume, VMT and speed on highways; station speed, volume, occupancy, VMT, VHT, travel time and delay; volumes by vehicle length; TriMet estimated transit load and speed by route; arterial speed, volume and occupancy; and a BikePed portal, with a downloads page for more data and documentation. Coverage is regional. Access is free on the web. Caveats: the licence is not stated on the page read, and the page does not list which agencies supply each feed. PORTAL supports calibration and validation of regional network flow models, reliability and incident analysis, and transit capacity studies. It complements Caltrans PeMS and the Seattle loop detector data set catalogued here.
